description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Juniper Order Ranger trigger.
Resolve the Juniper Order Ranger trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
